environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d (us-east-1a) as part of a Step Functions Express workflow. The API Gateway (REST, regional) triggers the state machine directly. The GraphQL product service runs on ECS Fargate at product-service.internal:4000 resolvable via Route53 private hosted zone. The Lambda has a VPC endpoint for Step Functions (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.states) and a NAT Gateway for outbound. API Gateway has no request validation template, no WAF association, and the Lambda execution role has states:SendTaskSuccess and full VPC networking permissions. The state machine definition passes API Gateway event directly as input to the Lambda task state without InputPath filtering.

config.api_gateway: REST API, regional, no request validation, no WAF
config.step_functions: Express workflow, Task state with direct event passthrough
config.graphql_service: ECS Fargate, no query complexity limits, no field-level auth
config.network: NAT Gateway for outbound, Route53 private zone for service discovery
